name: security-price-quote-binding-review
intent: Immutable quote capabilities and permitted quantity/recipient consumption
artifacts: Quote issuer/store, included product/quantity/customer/currency fields and purchase confirmation.
trace: Determine which quote fields the server trusts and whether a quote can be reused for a different customer, quantity or expired pricing context.
experiment: Issue an owned immutable quote capability, consume it under intended recipient/quantity/lifetime, then compare another recipient, changed quantity or forbidden repeated consumption. Preserve a deliberately honored guaranteed old price as a control.
disproof: A cached price is not underpayment unless the authoritative purchase accepts the forbidden quote context.
repair: Bind quote scope and validity to confirmation, preserving legitimate guaranteed-price windows.
branch_decisions: A quote may intentionally lock a price for a defined lifetime; expiry alone does not settle reuse after an approved extension. Determine which product/customer/quantity dimensions it covers. A rejected changed quote is a useful denial, not evidence that every unrelated quote field is protected.
operational_method: Specialize in quote capability lifecycle: immutable quote/version, recipient/customer, covered product/quantity, currency, validity and consumption state. Identify which fields are authenticated or looked up server-side and which the checkout recomputes. Compare a legitimate guaranteed stale price with unauthorized reuse for another customer/quantity or a second consumption contrary to policy. Keep an old accepted guarantee separate from a modified quote; ordinary payment-amount authority remains the payment-integrity workflow.
